crossRefs.note: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

people.name: Ard
people.line: Grandson of Benjamin, son of Bela

people.name: Bela
people.line: Son of Benjamin, head of the Belaite clan

people.name: Naaman
people.line: Grandson of Benjamin, head of the Naamite clan.

translations.web: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
translations.bsb: And the descendants of Bela from Ard and Naaman were the Ardite clan from Ard and the Naamite clan from Naaman.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
translations.asv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
